simple.prompt: You ___ wear a certified hard hat inside the construction zone; it is a strict safety law.
simple.explanation: 'Must' digunakan untuk menyatakan kewajiban mutlak atau keharusan hukum (strong obligation/legal requirement).
hints: Menyatakan aturan keselamatan wajib dan tegas.

simple.prompt: You look completely exhausted; you ___ get some proper rest tonight.
simple.explanation: 'Should' digunakan untuk memberikan saran, anjuran, atau rekomendasi baik (giving advice/recommendations).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kewajiban eksternal dengan 'have to'.
simple.targetSentence: We have to submit the tax documents by Friday.
simple.explanation: 'Have to' menyatakan keharusan yang bersumber dari aturan eksternal (undang-undang pajak/kebijakan instansi).
hints: Objek: the tax documents by Friday.

simple.prompt: Visitors ___ enter the private server room without an authorized security badge.
simple.explanation: 'Must not' (mustn't) menyatakan larangan keras (prohibition: dilarang keras).

simple.prompt: Today is an official company holiday, so we ___ attend the morning conference.
simple.explanation: 'Don't have to' menyatakan ketiadaan keharusan (lack of obligation: tidak perlu/tidak wajib, boleh tidak hadir). Berbeda dengan 'must not' yang bermakna larangan.
hints: Hari libur, jadi tidak ada kewajiban untuk masuk.

simple.targetSentence: You shouldn't drink coffee so late at night.
simple.explanation: Saran negatif: You shouldn't + base verb (drink) + coffee so late at night.

simple.prompt: Do we ___ show our physical passports at the domestic boarding gate?
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya dengan auxiliary 'Do/Does', gunakan 'have to': 'Do we have to...?' (Bukan 'Do we must').

simple.prompt: All lab visitors ___ wear safety goggles before entering Zone B.
simple.explanation: Aturan wajib keselamatan kerja menggunakan modal 'must' + bare infinitive ('wear').
hints: Konteksnya aturan keamanan yang wajib ditaati.
Modal 'must' diikuti kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

simple.prompt: You look exhausted after that twelve-hour shift; you ___ get some rest.
simple.explanation: 'Should' menyatakan saran atau nasihat yang baik dan peduli ('sebaiknya').
hints: Ini berupa saran ramah, bukan larangan keras.

simple.prompt: Passengers ___ smoke anywhere inside the terminal building. It is strictly prohibited.
simple.explanation: 'Mustn't' menyatakan larangan keras (dilarang), berbeda dengan 'don't have to' (tidak perlu/opsional).

simple.prompt: Tomorrow is a public holiday, so staff members ___ come to the office.
simple.explanation: Ketika sesuatu TIDAK wajib atau opsional ('tidak harus masuk kerja'), gunakan 'don't have to', bukan 'mustn't'.
hints: Apakah dilarang masuk atau hanya tidak wajib?
Tidak adanya kewajiban memakai 'don't have to'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang persyaratan dokumen masuk kantor.
dialogue: Do I need to wear a formal suit on Fridays?
No, you ___ wear a suit — smart casual is completely fine.
simple.explanation: Tidak adanya keharusan ('boleh kok tidak pakai jas') diungkapkan dengan 'don't have to'.
hints: Bukan larangan memakai jas, melainkan tidak wajib.

simple.prompt: ___ your sister have to work this coming Saturday morning?
simple.explanation: 'Have to' berfungsi seperti kata kerja biasa sehingga pertanyaan Present Simple subjek tunggal 'your sister' diawali auxiliary 'Does'.
hints: Pertanyaan Present Simple untuk 'have to' memakai 'Do/Does'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda modal dan preposisi 'to' pada kalimat saran berikut.
simple.draft: You should to verify the recipient's email address before clicking send.
options: You should verify the recipient's email address before clicking send.
You should verified the recipient's email address before clicking send.
You should verifying the recipient's email address before clicking send.
simple.explanation: Modal sejati ('should', 'must', 'can', 'may') langsung diikuti bare infinitive tanpa 'to': 'should verify'.
hints: Modal murni tidak pernah memakai 'to' sebelum verb.

simple.prompt: Drivers ___ exceed 40 km/h in this school zone.
simple.explanation: Batas kecepatan di zona sekolah adalah larangan resmi, sehingga memakai 'must not'.
hints: Melampaui batas kecepatan dilarang oleh aturan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kewajiban pribadi dengan 'have to'.
simple.targetSentence: I have to renew my driver's license before the end of May.
simple.explanation: Subject + have to + V1 ('renew') + object + time.

simple.targetSentence: You shouldn't skip breakfast before an early morning exam.
simple.explanation: Saran agar tidak melakukan sesuatu memakai 'shouldn't' + base verb 'skip'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di klinik dokter dengan modal anjuran formal.
dialogue: Your blood pressure is slightly elevated.
You ought ___ reduce sodium intake and exercise daily.
intermediate.explanation: Modal semi-auxiliary 'ought' SELALU berpasangan dengan infinitive 'to': 'ought to reduce' (maknanya setara dengan 'should').

intermediate.prompt: You ___ pay for the workshop materials; the corporate sponsorship covered all expenses.
intermediate.explanation: 'Needn't + base verb' (atau 'don't need to') bermakna 'tidak perlu' (lack of necessity). Biaya sudah ditanggung, jadi peserta tidak perlu membayar.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference: 'I ___ stop eating fast food; I really want to lead a healthier life.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, 'must' sering digunakan untuk kewajiban internal yang bersumber dari tekad pribadi si pembicara sendiri ('I must...').
hints: Keinginan dan tekad berasal dari dalam diri sendiri.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat keharusan masa lampau menggunakan 'had to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We had to cancel the outdoor seminar due to the thunderstorm.
intermediate.explanation: 'Must' tidak memiliki bentuk lampau sendiri; untuk menyatakan kewajiban di masa lalu, WAJIB menggunakan 'had to'.
hints: Bentuk lampau dari must/have to adalah 'had to'.

intermediate.prompt: If you want to catch the early express train, you ___ better leave right now.
intermediate.explanation: Idiom saran tegas yang disertai peringatan konsekuensi adalah 'had better + base verb': 'you had better leave' (sering disingkat 'you'd better').
hints: Formula saran kuat: had better + V1.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat peringatan dengan 'had better not'.
intermediate.targetSentence: You had better not miss the deadline.
intermediate.explanation: Pola negatif: Subject + had better not + base verb (miss) + the deadline.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih perbedaan antara larangan dan kebebasan memilih.
dialogue: No, you ___ touch them under any circumstances.
intermediate.explanation: Menyentuh patung adalah larangan keras yang berbahaya bagi karya seni, sehingga menggunakan 'mustn't'.

intermediate.prompt: Yesterday, the power failed, so we ___ save our files manually onto flash drives.
intermediate.explanation: Modal 'must' tidak memiliki bentuk lampau; untuk kewajiban di masa lalu ('Yesterday'), gunakan 'had to'.
hints: 'Must' tidak bisa berubah menjadi lampau; ganti dengan 'had to'.

intermediate.prompt: You ___ hurry or you'll miss the last airport shuttle!
intermediate.explanation: Peringatan mendesak dengan konsekuensi buruk ('or you'll miss...') memakai ungkapan baku 'had better + V1'.
hints: Ada konsekuensi jika tidak segera bertindak.
Rumus peringatan kuat: 'had better + bare infinitive'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang logistik mengenai ketiadaan kewajiban di masa lalu.
dialogue: Did you stay late to unpack those crates yesterday?
No, I ___ stay because the night crew handled them.
intermediate.explanation: Bentuk lampau untuk 'tidak perlu/tidak wajib' menggunakan auxiliary Past Simple 'didn't have to' + V1.
hints: Konteksnya kemarin dan bentuknya tidak wajib.
Lampau negatif dari 'have to' adalah 'didn't have to'.

intermediate.prompt: Before leaving the lab, employees ___ ensure all gas valves are shut.
intermediate.explanation: 'Ought' adalah semi-modal yang WAJIB menyertakan 'to' ('ought to + V1'), berfungsi setara dengan 'should'.

intermediate.prompt: We ___ wait three hours at the terminal because our flight was delayed by fog.
intermediate.explanation: Kewajiban atau keterpaksaan yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau ('was delayed') dinyatakan dengan 'had to'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk negatif pada ungkapan peringatan 'had better' berikut.
intermediate.draft: You hadn't better share your banking PIN over public hotel Wi-Fi.
options: You had better not share your banking PIN over public hotel Wi-Fi.
You hadn't better to share your banking PIN over public hotel Wi-Fi.
You better not to share your banking PIN over public hotel Wi-Fi.
intermediate.explanation: Bentuk negatif baku dari 'had better' meletakkan 'not' SETELAH 'better': 'had better not + V1' (bukan 'hadn't better').
hints: Periksa posisi kata 'not' dalam struktur 'had better'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice how internal vs external obligation works: when the team leader tells himself 'I really ___ learn SQL for my own growth', he uses...
intermediate.explanation: 'Must' sering menandai kewajiban/dorongan internal dari diri pembicara sendiri.
hints: Dorongan berasal dari tekad diri pembicara sendiri.

intermediate.prompt: Did your colleague ___ retake the safety certification test last Tuesday?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam pertanyaan Past Simple berawalan 'Did', semi-modal kembali ke bentuk dasar: 'have to'.
hints: Sudah ada auxiliary lampau 'Did' di awal pertanyaan.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat peringatan menggunakan 'had better not'.
intermediate.targetSentence: He had better not ignore the warning signal on the dashboard.
intermediate.explanation: 'Had better not' diikuti verb dasar 'ignore' tanpa 'to'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif lampau tentang kewajiban yang tidak perlu dilakukan.
intermediate.targetSentence: We didn't have to pay extra for checked baggage on that flight.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + didn't have to + V1 ('pay') menyatakan tidak adanya kewajiban di masa lalu.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan bentuk lampau modal keharusan.
complex.draft: Because the runway was flooded, the pilot must divert the aircraft to an alternate airport.
options: Because the runway was flooded, the pilot had to divert the aircraft to an alternate airport.
Because the runway was flooded, the pilot musted divert the aircraft to an alternate airport.
Because the runway was flooded, the pilot was must diverting the aircraft to an alternate airport.
complex.explanation: 'Must' tidak memiliki bentuk lampau (*musted tidak ada). Seluruh kewajiban di masa lampau wajib diungkapkan dengan 'had to': 'the pilot had to divert'.
hints: 'Must' tidak bisa dipakai dalam konteks kalimat lampau.

complex.prompt: Notice the subtle distinction: 'We ___ bought so much printer paper; the digital transformation eliminated all printing needs.'
complex.explanation: 'Needn't have + V3' berarti tindakan tersebut SUDAH terlanjur dilakukan padahal sebenarnya tidak perlu (an unnecessary action was performed). Sebaliknya 'didn't need to' berarti tidak perlu dan biasanya tidak dilakukan.
hints: Kertas sudah terlanjur dibeli padahal tidak dibutuhkan.

complex.prompt: You ___ brought an umbrella yesterday, but you left it at home and got completely soaked.
complex.explanation: 'Should have + V3' menyatakan penyesalan atau kritik atas kewajiban/tindakan baik yang SEHARUSNYA dilakukan di masa lalu tetapi TIDAK dilakukan.
hints: Menyatakan penyesalan atau anjuran masa lalu yang tidak terlaksana.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat kritik penyesalan masa lampau.
complex.targetSentence: We should have tested the backup system earlier.
complex.explanation: Subject (We) + should have + V3 (tested) + Object (the backup system) + Time (earlier).

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kerancuan antara deduksi masa lampau 'must have' dan keharusan 'had to'.
complex.draft: To renew his passport yesterday, he must have submit three biometric photographs.
options: To renew his passport yesterday, he had to submit three biometric photographs.
To renew his passport yesterday, he must had submitted three biometric photographs.
To renew his passport yesterday, he was having to submit three biometric photographs.
complex.explanation: Kalimat ini menyatakan syarat/kewajiban administratif yang harus dipenuhi di masa lalu (obligation in the past), sehingga harus menggunakan 'had to submit', bukan 'must have submit'.
hints: Menyatakan syarat kewajiban di masa lampau.

complex.prompt: The regulations require that every delegate ___ present their credentials upon entry.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa hukum formal (legal and regulatory English), modal 'shall' digunakan untuk menetapkan kewajiban resmi yang mengikat secara perundang-undangan.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog evaluasi pasca-krisis dengan kritik retrospektif.
dialogue: Why was the security patch delayed?
The team ___ deployed the update immediately after the vulnerability report.
complex.explanation: Kritik atas tindakan yang semestinya dilakukan di masa lalu: 'should have deployed'.
hints: Kritik atas tindakan yang seharusnya dilakukan.

complex.prompt: Compare carefully: 'We ___ bought extra umbrellas because the forecast changed and it stayed sunny' (we bought them unnecessarily).
complex.explanation: 'Needn't have + V3' menyatakan tindakan yang TERLANJUR dilakukan di masa lalu padahal ternyata tidak perlu ('sudah terlanjur beli, padahal cerah').
hints: Periksa V3 'bought' setelah rumpang dan maknanya terlanjur dilakukan.

complex.prompt: Now contrast: since the client already uploaded the blueprint, we ___ print fifty copies, so we saved a lot of paper.
complex.explanation: 'Didn't need to + V1' berarti tidak perlu dilakukan dan memang TIDAK dilakukan ('sehingga kami menghemat kertas').
hints: Lihat V1 'print' dan hasil akhir: kertas berhasil dihemat.
Tindakan tidak perlu dan tidak jadi dikerjakan memakai 'didn't need to'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penyesalan masa lampau pada kalimat pasca-rapat berikut.
complex.draft: We ought to double-check those shipment totals before sending the wire transfer yesterday.
options: We should have double-checked those shipment totals before sending the wire transfer yesterday.
We must have double-checked those shipment totals before sending the wire transfer yesterday.
We ought to double-checked those shipment totals before sending the wire transfer yesterday.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyesali hal yang seharusnya dilakukan kemarin tetapi terlewat, gunakan 'should have + V3' (atau 'ought to have + V3').
hints: Kejadiannya sudah terjadi kemarin dan merupakan penyesalan.
Penyesalan masa lampau memakai 'should have + V3'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan hukum tentang perjanjian formal yang menggunakan 'shall'.
dialogue: In Section 4.2, does 'The Licensee shall maintain valid insurance' mean a suggestion?
Not at all — in legal contracts, 'shall' imposes ___.
complex.explanation: Dalam dokumen hukum, regulasi, dan kontrak resmi, 'shall' dengan subjek orang ketiga menyatakan kewajiban mutlak yang mengikat secara hukum.
hints: Makna 'shall' di hukum adalah kewajiban resmi.

complex.prompt: They ___ have left the confidential prototype unattended in the public café; that violated company security.
complex.explanation: Kritik atas kesalahan yang sudah terlanjur dilakukan di masa lalu memakai 'shouldn't have + V3'.

complex.prompt: In strict academic prose, ___ is generally preferred over 'have got to' when stating procedural requirements.
complex.explanation: 'Have got to' tergolong percakapan/informal; tulisan akademik maupun teknis memakai 'must' atau konstruksi pasif formal 'is required to'.
hints: Cari bentuk yang cocok untuk ragam tulis akademik resmi.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penulisan ganda bentuk lampau pada modal penyesalan berikut.
complex.draft: You shouldn't have forgot to verify the client's passport expiration date.
options: You shouldn't have forgotten to verify the client's passport expiration date.
You shouldn't had forgotten to verify the client's passport expiration date.
You shouldn't forget to verify the client's passport expiration date yesterday.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'shouldn't have', gunakan Past Participle (V3) 'forgotten', bukan V2 'forgot'.

complex.prompt: All research manuscripts ___ include a clear statement disclosing any funding conflicts.
complex.explanation: Pedoman resmi jurnal ilmiah menyatakan syarat mutlak publikasi menggunakan modal tegas 'must'.
hints: Pernyataan kebijakan publikasi ilmiah memakai modal kewajiban jelas.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan masa lampau dengan 'ought to have'.
complex.targetSentence: They ought to have backed up the server before installing the update.
complex.explanation: Pola 'ought to have + V3' menyatakan kewajiban atau langkah bijak yang terlewat di masa lampau.
hints: Awali dengan 'They ought to have backed up'.
Lengkapi objek dan klausa 'before installing the update'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan masa lampau untuk tindakan yang tidak perlu namun terlanjur dilakukan.
complex.targetSentence: You needn't have brought your heavy tripod because the studio provided one.
complex.explanation: 'Needn't have + V3' berarti terlanjur membawa padahal sebenarnya tidak diperlukan.
